orgDesign.domainName: Privacy, Security and AI Governance Platform
orgDesign.companyProfile: Hypothetical mature operating model for this researched domain: 8 teams, 73 team FTE plus 5 group-direct FTE. This is not PrivacyPerfect’s actual headcount or organization; revenue and staffing are not established by the sources.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Value delivery owns records and accountable customer workflows; platform teams own trust and evidence contracts; expert enablement owns reviewed methods and adoption. Primary brick ownership is represented exclusively by team brickDependencies. Shared support is represented by otherTeamDependencies. Launch can combine responsibilities into fewer teams until workload justifies a split. Corporate sales, finance and HR are outside the total. No autonomous operational decision agents are assumed.
